name: Bharat Gothoskar
title: Ambassador of Mumbai
background: Mechanical Engineer, MBA with 16 years corporate marketing experience (Godrej, Pidilite, Mahindra). Founded Khaki Tours in 2015 & Khaki Heritage Foundation in 2018. Creator of world's first #UrbanSafari.

name: Aniket
title: Bombay High Court Lawyer & Legal Historian
background: Originally from Pune; fell in love with Mumbai through a Khaki walk and now guides guests through legal lore, High Court precincts, and colonial administrative history.

name: Anvi
title: Spanish Language Expert & Cultural Interpreter
background: Former Rotary Youth Ambassador in the US. Returned to Mumbai after global travel to interpret the city's living stories for international guests.

name: Preeti
title: Anaesthetist & Heritage Volunteer
background: Medical doctor who enlivens visitors on weekends with vibrant cultural history, medical heritage of Bombay, and plague history anecdotes.

name: Samruddhi
title: Banking Professional & Financial Historian
background: Weekday banker, weekend historian who uncovers Mumbai’s financial evolution, Bombay Stock Exchange lore, and mint architecture.

name: Aanchal
title: Communications Professional & Classical Dancer
background: Classical Indian dancer and brand communications expert who brings Mumbai's rhythmic cultural stories and temple performance arts alive.

name: Adithi
title: MBA Researcher & Suburban Storyteller
background: Storyteller who guides guests through Bollywood lore, historic suburban gaothans, and vibrant street life.

name: Aditi
title: Education Researcher
background: Returned to Mumbai after 11 years to unearth hidden architectural secrets, colonial schooling foundations, and library heritage with residents and visitors.

name: Aditya
title: Supply Chain Transformation Executive
background: Weekend history buff sharing tales of Mumbai’s sea trade, cotton booms, dockyards, and colonial economic expansion.

name: Ajay
title: Venture Capital Investor
background: Discovered Mumbai’s heritage by chance; now invests his weekends sharing heritage stories, architectural preservation, and urban safari trails.
